BREAKING — Eladio Tovar Jr. was arrested Tuesday afternoon, October 20, 2026, at 2:06 p.m., on two felony charges of unauthorized use of a vehicle, according to Webb County booking records.

Tovar was booked into the Webb County Jail on two counts: (1) unauthorized use of a vehicle (charge code UNAUTH USE OF VEHICLE), a state jail felony under Texas law, with bond NOT set; and (2) unauthorized use of a vehicle (charge code UNAUTHORIZED USE OF VEHICLE), a state jail felony, with bond set at $15,000.

A state jail felony in Texas is punishable by 180 days to two years in a state jail facility and a fine of up to $10,000. The records reviewed by Webb Watch 956 do not describe the alleged incidents or identify the vehicles involved, and the booking record does not list an arresting agency — the holding-agency field was blank.

Webb Watch 956 will follow these cases as they move through the Webb County courts.

An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction. Eladio Tovar Jr. is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search (Oct. 20, 2026); Webb County public-access court records, Tyler Odyssey portal.

— Walter Webb & Willa Webb, News Anchors, Webb Watch 956
